description: Leading the organization's strategic AI transformation. Architecting generative AI systems, LLM pipelines, and cloud-native platforms for enterprise-scale deployment. Bridging deep technical architecture with executive AI strategy and ROI frameworks.

Grew from Head of Development through Head of R&D to CTO over nine years. Owned the full technical vision: distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and platform architecture across more than a dozen client industries. Built and scaled engineering teams through every stage of company growth.
Venture-level oversight for portfolio companies. Advised on technical architecture, engineering team structure, and growth strategy at the intersection of technology and business.

Founded and led Fabricks, which built atomic building components for Smart Factories. Products optimized warehouse logistics, supply chain processes, and internal digitalization for manufacturing clients. Full-stack responsibility from product vision to customer delivery.
Mentoring the next generation of software engineers at the peer-to-peer programming school. Contributing real-world engineering leadership perspective to a community that learns by building.
External lecturer at the WASA research group. Eight years of academic research conducted alongside industry work, combining rigorous methodology with production engineering reality.
